parsed.text: Panel p0 current estimates: n0 shows a concentrated blue peak at cell (0,1) and a concentrated red peak at (0,3). Current distributions for n1, n2 and n3 are uniform over the 4×4 grid. Candidate (conditional) records differ by command: for k0 and k2, n0 matches the concentrated peaks; for k1 n0 is the same. For node n3, k1 concentrates blue mass on the four cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) and red on the four cells (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1); k2 concentrates blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1); k0 leaves n3 uniform. Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are conditional estimates, not events that have already occurred.
